s: IoT sensors are manufactured with certificates from a private CA. They must only connect to AWS after physical installation. Which solution meets this requirement?
o: Use a Lambda function as a pre-provisioning hook to validate the serial number, and register each device (RegisterThing) during manufacturing.
Use Step Functions to validate the serial number, and start a thing registration task during installation.
Use a Lambda function as a pre-provisioning hook to validate the serial number, register the CA with AWS IoT Core, and enable auto-registration so each device registers on its first connection.
Use a provisioning template with parameter validation, and provision a claim certificate and private key for each device.
e: AWS IoT Core'spre-provisioning hook allows custom logic (like serial number validation)beforea device is registered. This ensures that only installed devices connect. Lambda is ideal for such logic. AWS IoT Just-in-Time Provisioning
x: This is the same scenario as A132 (keyed C). Registering things at manufacturing (A) lets sensors connect before installation. Register the CA with IoT Core, enable auto-registration and validate the serial number with a pre-provisioning Lambda hook, so a device registers on first connection after installation.
